scenes.title: Breakfast at Villa Diodati
scenes.text: Breakfast at Villa Diodati; Byron and Polidori talk over news and weather. Stormy period begins over Lake Geneva.

quotes.quote: Three days of rain confined us to the house.

scenes.title: Shelley, Mary, and Claire come over from nearby lodging to visit Byron
scenes.text: Shelley, Mary, and Claire come over from nearby lodging to visit Byron. They were staying at Maison Chapuis and visited often.

scenes.title: Conversation on poetry and nature
scenes.text: Conversation on poetry and nature; Percy may recite; everyone staying indoors. Plausible reconstruction.

scenes.title: Rain intensifies
scenes.text: Rain intensifies; candles lit early; they stay in the salon. Bad weather is well-attested for this period.

scenes.title: Dinner together
scenes.text: Dinner together; lively talk about travels and letters from England. Shared meals at Diodati are consistent with accounts.

scenes.title: They bring out a volume of ghost/fantastic stories (Fantasmagoriana)…
scenes.text: They bring out a volume of ghost/fantastic stories (Fantasmagoriana) and begin reading. Sets up the later challenge.
scenes.mood: heavy rain, thunder close, candlelit reading

quotes.quote: We talked of the experiments of Dr. Darwin, who preserved a piece of vermicelli in a glass case till by some extraordinary means it began to move.

scenes.title: Byron reads aloud
scenes.text: Byron reads aloud; Mary listens intently; Polidori watches everyone's reactions. Evening storytelling is widely cited.
scenes.mood: dim, storm lashing shutters, slightly theatrical

quotes.quote: I am as melancholy as a cat in a strange garret.

scenes.title: The storm peaks
scenes.text: The storm peaks; they break up for the night, minds excited by the tales. End of first storm night.
scenes.mood: loud thunder, flickering candles, night over lake

scenes.title: Late breakfast
scenes.text: Late breakfast; they talk about last night's German ghost stories. Polidori diary confirms bad weather and reading.

scenes.title: Byron proposes: each of us should write a tale of terror
scenes.text: Byron proposes: each of us should write a tale of terror. Polidori diary 16 June: 'Proposed that each should write a tale of terror.'
scenes.mood: rain on windows, charged, playful but competitive

quotes.quote: Proposed that each should write a tale of terror.

scenes.title: Shelley and Byron drift into talk of science, Darwin, galvanism
scenes.text: Shelley and Byron drift into talk of science, Darwin, galvanism; Mary listens. This conversation is what Mary later said lodged in her mind.
scenes.mood: brief lull in rain, overcast light

quotes.quote: We talked of the experiments of Dr. Darwin, who preserved a piece of vermicelli in a glass case till by some extraordinary means it began to move.

scenes.title: Everyone attempts to start a story
scenes.text: Everyone attempts to start a story; Mary struggles to find an idea; Polidori drafts something light. Mary in 1831 preface: she 'had thought more, and written less.'
scenes.mood: rain resumes, studious, everyone at tables or writing-desks

scenes.title: Tea and philosophy: life, death, creation, can life be reanimated?
scenes.text: Tea and philosophy: life, death, creation, can life be reanimated? This is the exact thematic soil for Frankenstein.

quotes.quote: The mind in creation is as a fading coal, which some invisible influence, like an inconstant wind, awakens to transitory brightness.

scenes.title: Dinner
scenes.text: Dinner; Claire tries to engage Byron; social undercurrents present. Claire's pursuit of Byron is historically attested.

quotes.quote: He will not look at me, yet I am ever near him.

scenes.title: They regroup in the salon
scenes.text: They regroup in the salon; thunderstorm flares again over the lake. Set the scene explicitly in prompts for ambience.
scenes.mood: dramatic lightning, good for horror mood

scenes.title: They begin to share or describe the stories they have in mind
scenes.text: They begin to share or describe the stories they have in mind; Byron sketches his Eastern fragment. Byron's fragment later influences Polidori's Vampyre.

quotes.quote: Began my story — the nobleman who destroys by fascination.

scenes.title: Night winds down
scenes.text: Night winds down; Mary is still without a fully formed story but is agitated by the talk. This sets up Mary's 'waking dream' on the 17th.

quotes.quote: When I placed my head on my pillow, I did not sleep, nor could I be said to think; my imagination, unbidden, possessed and guided me.

scenes.title: Mary is thoughtful and quiet at breakfast
scenes.text: Mary is thoughtful and quiet at breakfast; Percy attentive. Mary later dates the key image to the night/morning after the challenge.

quotes.quote: The thunderstorm was terrific... The lake was lit up, the pines on Jura made distinct, and the streams of rain seemed like silver wires.

scenes.title: Byron writes letters
scenes.text: Byron writes letters; Polidori works up his own material; others read. Polidori diary mentions writing.

scenes.title: Mary articulates the vision that came to her: a 'pale student of…
scenes.text: Mary articulates the vision that came to her: a 'pale student of unhallowed arts' animating a creature. From Mary Shelley's 1831 preface.

quotes.quote: I saw the pale student of unhallowed arts kneeling beside the thing he had put together.
The mind in creation is as a fading coal, which some invisible influence, like an inconstant wind, awakens to transitory brightness.

scenes.title: Byron and Shelley walk briefly by the lake despite weather, speaking of…
scenes.text: Byron and Shelley walk briefly by the lake despite weather, speaking of Prometheus and creation. Promethean themes connect to Shelley's interests.
scenes.mood: cloudy, mist on lake, short outdoor interlude

quotes.quote: There are things which neither poetry nor philosophy can define — but we may attempt them still.

scenes.title: Quieter dinner
scenes.text: Quieter dinner; everyone returns to the ghost-story task. Tension has cooled into work.

scenes.title: Evening writing session
scenes.text: Evening writing session; Mary begins shaping her narrative; Polidori refines his vampire material. This is where your sim can branch into the famous works.

quotes.quote: Began my story — the nobleman who destroys by fascination.

scenes.title: Late-night vigil
scenes.text: Late-night vigil; each is absorbed in their own tale. End of the 3-day arc.
scenes.mood: very quiet, lake dark, occasional rain
